senses.gloss: f.(b. h. סְגֻלָּה; סָגַל)safe investment, heirloom, family relic, treasure. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 2 (ref. to סגלה, Ex. XIX, 5) מה סְגוּלָּתוֹ של אדם וכ׳ as the heirloom a man possesses is dear to him, so &c.; Pesik. R. s. 11, end.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 52a:1">B. Bath. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>קבל מן הקטן יעשה לו ס׳</he> if one receives a trust from a minor, he must invest it safely (since he cannot return it to him until he is of age).
Ib. מאי ס׳ וכ׳ what is a s’gullah?… A scroll of the Law; … a date-tree.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 87b:13">B. Kam. 87ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 9:8">Tosef. ib. IX, 8</cite>, sq.; a. e.
